usage: probe-agent [-q] [--json] [-c | -r NAME] "message"
       probe-agent --list

Answers one message in a new conversation and prints the answer; the steps taken go to standard error.

  --json    print the whole run as JSON lines
  -c        continue the latest conversation
  -r NAME   continue the conversation NAME
  --list    print the conversations' names, newest first
